pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pHolds a circuit board to contribute stability to a Locator platform.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Place the plug at controller height on Stable Stone.$p2. Insert a stable analysed board.$p3. Read the active state and recheck the surrounding Locator square.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pA dirty chip or unanalysed/unstable board is not a stabilizing board. Plugs are not generic FE storage blocks.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
